24/7 incident response

What happens when we spot a threat.

  1. Minute 0: DetectOur tools flag unusual activity, like a login from a new country at 3am.
  2. Minute 4: ConfirmA real analyst checks the alert and rules out false alarms.
  3. Minute 11: ContainWe isolate the device or account so the attacker can't go further.
  4. Hour 1: ReportYou get a plain-English summary of what happened and what we did.
Client story

A ransomware attack, stopped in 9 minutes.

"At 2am someone got into an old staff account. Bastion locked it before a single file was encrypted. We only found out when we read their report over breakfast."

FAQ

Questions

Do small businesses really need cyber security?

Yes. Small businesses are targeted because they usually have weaker protection. Basic steps like two-step login, backups and staff training stop most common attacks.

What is a security operations centre (SOC)?

A SOC is a team of security analysts who watch your systems all day and night, investigate alerts and respond to attacks. With Bastion, you get this without hiring your own team.

How much does managed cyber security cost?

Our packages start at $15 per employee per month. Most businesses with 24/7 monitoring pay $32 per employee per month.

What should I do if I think we've been hacked?

Don't turn devices off or pay any ransom. Disconnect affected devices from the network and call our 24/7 incident line on +1 (800) 555-0199.

Get a free security review.

In 45 minutes, a senior analyst will review your setup and give you a short list of the risks that matter most, even if you never hire us.

# Cyber Security

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/saas-landing/cyber-security/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
